links.comparator_used: AI-drafted message content with no disclosure (also compared with a human-authorship disclosure)
links.outcome: Patient satisfaction with message responses (5-point Likert scale)
links.effect: No disclosure scored higher than AI authorship disclosure by a mean difference of 0.09 (95% CI, 0.01-0.17) points. Human disclosure scored higher than AI disclosure by 0.13 (95% CI, 0.05-0.22) points. More than 75% of respondents were satisfied regardless of author or disclosure type.
links.tradeoff: Disclosing AI involvement slightly reduced patient satisfaction. The authors still recommend maintaining disclosure to uphold patient autonomy and empowerment.
links.quote: Participants tended to have higher satisfaction with a human disclosure over AI disclosure, with a mean difference of 0.13 (95% CI, 0.05-0.22) points, and with no disclosure over AI authorship disclosure, with a mean difference of 0.09 (95% CI, 0.01-0.17) points.
